The '''Integrated Public Address System''' was a portable [[Speaker/Legends|speaker]] setup used when a full stage arrangement was unavailable. It included a stand, [[Microphone/Legends|microphone]] receiver, several speakers, and a [[Power cell/Legends|power pack]], all packed into a [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]] that also served as a makeshift soapbox. The system was lightweight and easy to carry, and its power supply allowed it to operate for one [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] before needing a recharge.<ref name="Desperate Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Integrated Public Address System was first mentioned in ''[[Desperate Allies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] supplementary sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' series that was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2015]].<ref name="Desperate Allies" />
